import subprocess,json,hashlib
root=Path('products/services/tender-instant-preview')
report={'synthetic_only':True,'runs':[],'hashes':{}}
for name in ['tests/parity.py','tests/ui_test.py']:

 r=subprocess.run(['python3',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
 report['runs'].append({'command':['python3',str(p)],'returncode':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr})

 if p.is_file(): report['hashes'][str(p)]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for name in ['result.json','src/core.js','tools/build.py']:
 p=root/name
 print('\nREVIEW SOURCE '+str(p)+'\n'+p.read_text())
out=Path('products/reviews/tender-preview-independent-execution.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('\nEXECUTED REPORT\n'+out.read_text())
